# Equalizer APO 1.4.2

SoundStage redistributes the x64 runtime files from the unmodified official
Equalizer APO 1.4.2 installer. Equalizer APO is licensed under
GPL-2.0-or-later.

- Project: https://sourceforge.net/projects/equalizerapo/
- Release:
  https://sourceforge.net/projects/equalizerapo/files/1.4.2/
- Upstream binary installer SHA-256:
  `7403BE7427BBE1936A40DDED082829B6E217FC4F5990FEE5CBA501F0AE055AFA`
- Complete corresponding source:
  `source/EqualizerAPO-src-1.4.2.zip`

SoundStage installs Equalizer APO only on detected AirPods A2DP Stereo render
endpoints and preserves the endpoint's original audio effects for chaining and
uninstallation.
